The **Bow** is a ranged weapon in *Fallout 76*, introduced in the *Wastelanders* update.

A simple recurve bow made of polished wood. The bow has high damage and rate of fire, but can only have one arrow nocked at a time. As all other bows, the Compound Bow is a silent weapon, meaning that it has a sneak attack functionality similar to that of a Suppressor. It cannot be equipped while wearing Power Armor.
